name: Mizuna Torineko
source:
The assistant to Soraoka Yuuhi, who has become a famous detective.

She excels at all sports, is loyal to her friends, is straightforward, and is decisive.

Although she has a likable personality, her careless words and actions sometimes leads to conflict.

She has no interest in sexual matters and looks down on students who are in heat, but she is actually a secret masochist... something she doesn’t even realize herself.
